questions.prompt: What is the primary requirement for the repair to be free of charge?
options: The customer must provide a paper receipt.
The issue must stem from a factory defect.
The repair must take less than ten business days.
The laptop must be less than one month old.

questions.prompt: Why is the customer's recent software installation a potential problem?
options: It likely cracked the screen from the inside.
It could make the manufacturer’s warranty expire early.
It might result in a service charge even if the hardware is fine.
The laptop is too old to run graphic design suites.

questions.prompt: What is the main difference between the limited and extended plans?
options: The Limited plan only covers software issues.
The Extended plan ignores the cause of the damage.
The Limited plan provides a free loaner laptop.
The Extended plan is only for professional designers.

questions.prompt: What is the shortest amount of time the customer could be without a laptop?
options: One hour.
One week.
Ten business days.
Fourteen business days.

questions.prompt: If the customer needs a computer to meet their deadlines, they must...
options: Pay a weekly fee for a temporary device.
Wait at the shop for the repair to finish.
Buy a second high-end laptop.
Back up their files to the cloud.

questions.prompt: What is the customer's hope regarding the ribbon cable?
options: That it is a software-based problem.
That it is an expensive part to replace.
That it is a hardware defect covered by the warranty.
That it can be fixed without sending the laptop away.
